page.overview:
Who is Stevie Robins?

Stevie Robins is the main antagonist of The Scoop, the second story in Fazbear Frights 12: Felix the Shark.

Stevie is a small boy with somewhat spiky and mussed brown hair, brown eyes, jeans, blue sneakers, and a bright red shirt with Sideshow on it. As a ghost, he has huge and sharp teeth. As Mandy continues to see Stevie his skin gets paler, his cheeks sink in, dark circles rim his dark eyes, and his hair gets limp and greasy. Eventually dark veins line his face and his hair thins out, exposing parts of his skull.
